description: Predicts the y-value for a given x-value using simple linear regression (least squares method) fitted to the provided data points. (cost: 1 credit)

target_x.description: number, required, the x-value for which to predict y

x_values.description: array of numbers, required, the x-coordinates of data points

y_values.description: array of numbers, required, the y-coordinates of data points (same length as x_values)

name: linear_regression_prediction
